root_cause: A refactor introduced a call to sqlite3TableColumnToStorage(), a helper whose safety contract requires the caller to pre-validate the column index against pTab->nCol (enforced only via a debug assert), without adding that validation at the call site in the public preupdate API. The caller (sqlite3_preupdate_old) incorrectly assumed the callee would perform range checking, while the callee assumed the caller already had.
findings: sqlite3_preupdate_old() takes a caller-supplied column index `iIdx` and, when the table has no rowid alias handled via pPk, passes it directly to sqlite3TableColumnToStorage(p->pTab, iIdx) without first verifying that `iIdx` is within `[0, p->pTab->nCol)`. sqlite3TableColumnToStorage() only guards this precondition with `assert(iCol<pTab->nCol)`, which is compiled out in release (NDEBUG) builds.
